newsitem.title: USA: AT&T begins Iowa arbitration with U S West.
newsitem.headline: AT&T begins Iowa arbitration with U S West.

text.p: AT&T Corp said arbitration proceedings with U S West Communications Group begin Wednesday in an effort to bring local telephone service competition to Iowa.
During the arbitration, the Iowa Utilities Board will hear testimony from both companies and other potential new entrants, AT&T noted.
Under the federal Telecommunications Act passed earlier this year, companies seeking to offer local service can ask state regulators to intervene and settle disputed or unresolved issues.
Formal talks between the two companies began March 1 when AT&T asked U S West to negotiate an agreement to allow it to connect to the local telephone network.
